svg.aria-label: TrueStrike architecture: CLI drives the TrueForge harness; subagents run tools in a Daytona sandbox; intrusive actions pause at the localhost MCP exploit gateway for human approval (request_intrusive_approval); outcomes are recorded by the harness without human pause (record_exploit_outcome); audit ledger logs one-time authorizationIds; sandbox reaches Juice Shop through Cloudflare relay.
